The console selects `barcode`, which `type Item` lacks. HEAD 2b80361b (verifier, on a copy): no MESSAGE_TYPE node, `[graphql-sdl] files=1 resolvers=4`; graded node 0/1, cells 0/3, forbid 0. Graded at d8051a4b (DT.11a landed in w15): GRAPHQL_CALLS 2/2. The verdicts are contract_fields rows, which no key field expresses: engine/tests/model_graphql.rs pins `mutation AdjustStock adjustStock` identical and `query ListItems items` breaking (barcode graphql_field_undefined).
